label: D1 after an unrewarded trial (esp. a run of losses) while the policy still leans to a1
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2), and 98% of its activation mass falls on D1 steps where the reward input is 0, i.e. the previous trial was unrewarded. Within those steps it is selective: about 89% of mass falls where the upcoming choice is a1, and at D1 the policy logit is moderately positive (logit(a1)-logit(a2) between about 3 and 8). It does not fire after rewarded trials (0.1% rate), on fixation errors, or near the very end of the episode (trials 90-99). Activation is stronger after consecutive losses: the top windows have 3-4 unrewarded trials in a row, and requiring the trial before last to also be unrewarded (or outside the window) roughly doubles precision. Recorded predicate (dev F1 0.55, mass recall 0.83): D1, previous trial unrewarded, the a1-vs-a2 policy logit of the model > 4, and the trial before that not rewarded. It uses only observed history plus the current policy readout of the model, so no future variables. Using the upcoming action == 1 instead of the logit gives similar but slightly worse results. Precision stays incomplete (~0.45): many D1 steps that match the description are silent, which suggests a further gating that I could not capture (e.g. ep_trial and since-reversal effects).
